recommendations.recommendation: Reject modern Western civilization, which is a disease that makes bodily comfort its goal.
recommendations.rationale: It is irreligious, enslaves people to machines and money, and will destroy itself; Indians are enslaved by it, not by the English.

recommendations.recommendation: Understand swaraj as rule over oneself, not as English rule without the English.
recommendations.rationale: Driving out the English while keeping their system would mean keeping the tiger's nature without the tiger.
recommendations.argued_against: nationalists who want a Westernized India

recommendations.recommendation: Begin self-rule in your own life now rather than waiting for others.
recommendations.rationale: Swaraj experienced by each person who rules himself is real swaraj, and it spreads from individuals.

recommendations.recommendation: Use soul-force, or passive resistance, rather than brute force.
recommendations.rationale: Soul-force harms no one, falls only on the resister if he is wrong, and history shows love sustaining the world more than force.

recommendations.recommendation: Reject violence and assassination, because means and ends are inseparable.
recommendations.rationale: The means are like the seed and the end like the tree; violent means produce violent results.
recommendations.argued_against: extremists who justify bombings and murder

recommendations.recommendation: Recognize that passive resistance requires more courage than violence.
recommendations.rationale: Facing suffering without striking back takes greater bravery than using a weapon.
recommendations.argued_against: the view that nonviolence is cowardice

recommendations.recommendation: As a passive resister, practice chastity, poverty, truth, and fearlessness.
recommendations.rationale: These disciplines give the strength needed to bear suffering for truth.
recommendations.scope: those who would serve as passive resisters

recommendations.recommendation: Do not hate the English; oppose their civilization and wrongs, not them as people.
recommendations.rationale: Hatred harms the hater; the English are welcome to stay if they adopt Indian ways.

recommendations.recommendation: Value ancient Indian civilization and its simplicity, limiting wants.
recommendations.rationale: The ancients deliberately limited indulgences and chose simple tools and villages because happiness is a state of mind.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid relying on railways and machine travel.
recommendations.rationale: Railways spread plague and famine, extend British control, and make holy places unholy by easing access for bad people.
recommendations.argued_against: those who see railways as progress

recommendations.recommendation: Settle disputes among yourselves instead of going to lawyers and courts.
recommendations.rationale: Lawyers profit from quarrels, foment Hindu-Muslim disputes, and courts strengthen British rule.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid Western doctors and medicine that encourage indulgence.
recommendations.rationale: Doctors relieve the consequences of overeating and vice, so people indulge more; medicine also involves vivisection.

recommendations.recommendation: Reject machinery and return to handicrafts such as the handloom and spinning wheel.
recommendations.rationale: Machinery is the chief symbol of modern civilization and impoverished India; Manchester cloth destroyed Indian handicrafts.

recommendations.recommendation: Educate for character and self-control rather than mere literacy or English learning.
recommendations.rationale: Letters without character are useless; English education enslaves the nation.

recommendations.recommendation: Learn and use your mother tongue and Indian languages, with Hindi as the common tongue.
recommendations.rationale: Depending on English is slavery; every Indian should know his own language, Hindi, and classical tongues like Sanskrit.

recommendations.recommendation: Treat India as one nation and cultivate Hindu-Muslim unity.
recommendations.rationale: Different faiths are different roads to the same goal, and mutual quarrels were stirred up by outsiders.

recommendations.recommendation: Protect the cow through persuasion and appeal, never by killing or coercing Muslims.
recommendations.rationale: Killing a person to save a cow would make one an enemy of both cow and person.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not imitate the British Parliament as a model of government.
recommendations.rationale: Parliament is sterile and at the mercy of ministers, achieving nothing of its own will.

recommendations.recommendation: Respect the early Congress leaders and moderates, while choosing your own path.
recommendations.rationale: Elders like Dadabhai Naoroji laid the groundwork for national awakening and deserve gratitude.
